settings.prompt: Create one 2x2 turnaround sheet of the same full-body cow on white. Top-left true front: symmetric chest and both eyes visible. Top-right true rear: back and tail visible, no face. Bottom-left exact right profile facing right. Bottom-right exact left profile facing left. Equal size and foot line. No text, border, shadow, or cropping.
settings.negativePrompt: text, labels, watermark, frame, border, cropped subject, multiple unrelated subjects
